blurb: The Jump Shack offers in-ground trampolines that are flush with the ground, eliminating ladder access and reducing fall risks. Their trampolines blend with garden landscapes and provide a better bounce quality due to a rigid frame and vented pads. They provide kits for DIY installation and offer support for installation and drainage advice.
